title: Anime Matsuri Grand Expo
description: Three days of voice actor panels, cosplay championships, and world premiere screenings.
fullDetails: Featuring exclusive sneak peeks of Crimson Blade Chronicles Arc 2, autograph signings with veteran animators, and an international cosplay runway contest with over $10,000 in grand prizes.

title: Skybound Academy Screening Night
description: Exclusive advance theatrical screening of episodes 1-3 with cast Q&A session.
fullDetails: Fans will experience the stunning aerial battles of Skybound Academy on the giant IMAX screen, followed by a live panel with director Kenji Sato and the primary voice cast.

title: Sakura Soundtracks Live Orchestra
description: A 60-piece orchestra performing iconic anime themes under giant synchronized visual projections.
fullDetails: Conducted by Maestro Hiroshi Tanba, this unforgettable evening brings epic anime fight themes and emotional acoustic ballads to life with choir and full brass sections.

title: Neon Harbor Speedrun Invitational
description: Top international speedrunners compete live for world records in Ashen Kingdoms and Neon Harbor.
fullDetails: Watch nail-biting frame-perfect glitches, glitchless any% marathons, and four-way head-to-head races cast by leading community commentators with live charity donation milestones.

title: Fortress Tactics Championship Finals
description: The ultimate showdown of sixteen grandmaster tacticians vying for the World Aegis Trophy.
fullDetails: Over eight hours of intense siege strategy, real-time counter-picks, and expert meta-breakdowns culminating in the best-of-seven grand finals.

title: Indie Game Developers Showcase
description: Hands-on playtests of over 100 upcoming indie games with meet-and-greets with creators.
fullDetails: Discover hidden gems, test unreleased playable alpha builds, attend workshops on game design and pixel art, and vote in the Fan Choice Indie Awards.

title: Midnight Reel Sci-Fi Film Festival
description: A weekend celebration of restored sci-fi classics and debut indie space thrillers.
fullDetails: Screenings include the 4K restoration of Skyline, followed by a director panel on practical special effects vs CGI, prop workshops, and midnight mystery screenings.

title: The Lighthouse Protocol Gala Premiere
description: Star-studded red carpet premiere featuring cast arrivals and director introduction.
fullDetails: Celebrate the premiere of the year's most anticipated sci-fi thriller. VIP attendees receive commemorative film programs and entry to the after-party lounge.

title: Behind the Lens: Cinematography Masterclass
description: An interactive workshop on anamorphic lenses, lighting dark spaces, and pacing suspense.
fullDetails: Award-winning director of photography Elena Rostova breaks down key scenes from hit films frame by frame, showing lighting setups and camera rigs used in production.

title: Harrow Point Mystery Season 2 Watch Party
description: Live synchronized season launch with community theory sessions and detective trivia.
fullDetails: Join thousands of fellow mystery fans as the opening two episodes stream live on the big screen, followed by real-time community clue hunting and prize giveaways.

title: Kingsbridge Period Drama Costume Gala
description: Exhibition of authentic Victorian gowns, coats, and period craftsmanship from the series.
fullDetails: Walk through reconstructed Victorian sets, admire hand-stitched period costumes up close, and enjoy tea while costume designer Margaret Byrne gives guided tours.

title: Television Writers' Room Live Roundtable
description: Showrunners and scriptwriters reveal how to construct multi-season character arcs.
fullDetails: From pilot pitch to season finale, four leading TV writers share their whiteboard outlining techniques, how to handle cliffhangers, and how fan feedback shapes writer rooms.

title: Lunar Bloom World Stadium Tour: Kickoff
description: The explosive first stadium concert of Lunar Bloom's 'Moonrise' world tour.
fullDetails: Featuring a massive heart-shaped stage, synchronized lightstick stadium ocean waves, pyrotechnics, and live band arrangements of all mini-album hits.

title: K-Pop Random Dance & Fan Festival
description: Hundreds of fans gather for public random dance play, photocard trading, and fan merch stalls.
fullDetails: Show off your choreography skills to the latest hits, trade rare official album photocards with fellow stans, and win official albums and lightsticks in dance-off battles.

title: Starlight Idol Global Auditions & Workshop
description: Vocal training, stage projection clinics, and dance classes led by top Seoul choreographers.
fullDetails: Aspiring performers receive master coaching in stage presence, vocal endurance, and formation discipline directly from industry choreographers and vocal directors.

title: Crescent City Comic Con
description: The premier comic book gathering with over 200 artists, rare back-issue vendors, and panels.
fullDetails: Meet legendary cover pencillers, get your favorite issues signed and CGC graded, attend panels on graphic novel storytelling, and browse vintage comic bins.

title: Ghostlight 10th Anniversary Retrospective
description: Gallery exhibition of original ink pages, script drafts, and variant cover artwork.
fullDetails: Tracing a decade of Crescent City's dark guardian. Highlights include original pencils from issue #1, character concept sheets, and limited-edition anniversary prints.

title: Indie Comic Creators Portfolio Review
description: Aspiring writers and illustrators pitch their creator-owned comics to publishing editors.
fullDetails: One-on-one portfolio critiques, practical panels on self-publishing and crowdfunding comic books, and networking mixers with seasoned letterers, colorists, and inkers.

title: Tokyo Manga Fest & Doujin Market
description: The world's largest gathering of self-published manga creators and professional serial artists.
fullDetails: Explore thousands of independent creator circles, pick up exclusive art books and doujinshi, and witness live digital drawing demonstrations on high-end pen displays.

title: Tidewalker Volume 12 Midnight Launch
description: Midnight book release party with commemorative poster gifts and trivia contests.
fullDetails: Celebrate the climax of the Storm Arc! Early purchasers receive an exclusive holographic bookmark, foil bookplate, and a collectible tote bag while supplies last.

title: Mangaka Studio Tour & Inking Masterclass
description: Live demonstration of traditional G-pen inking, screen tones, and panel composition.
fullDetails: Experience the classic craft of manga production. Learn how line weight directs reader gaze, master knife scraping techniques on screech tones, and ask questions live.
